title: A Voyager 1 map of Jupiter, 27 February 1979 (2025 version)

statements.text: Björn Jónsson, from NASA/JPL Voyager images archived at the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node
statements.scope: The map: 270 Voyager 1 narrow-angle frames (135 orange, 135 violet) taken on 1979-02-27 between 03:55:47 and 12:52:35, reprojected, illumination-adjusted and mosaicked by the author.

statements.text: Publicly available; no permission needed; credit "created by Björn Jónsson". The author asks sites to link to his maps, not to host a copy.
Green is synthetic: the frames are orange and violet only. Smooth dummy data fills gaps near the poles; the author's mask marks it, with real data he judged useless and small manual seam repairs.
statements.scope: Color and polar coverage of the map.
